note: Work packages of docs/design/COLLECTION_FISHING_ADDENDUM.md. One package per independently buildable unit. Fields per package: id, title, phase, wave, depends_on (hard), soft_depends_on, files (owned; disjoint across packages except sharedEdits), deliverables, tests, acceptance, estimate (dev-days, excluding art).
